According to another legend - the beginning of the tradition to paint eggs was laid by the Virgin Mary, who painted eggs to entertain Jesus Christ when he was still a baby. The color of an egg depends on what it is painted with, and the color itself also matters: red is a royal color, reminds of God's love for the human race, and blue is the color of the Blessed Virgin, it is associated with kindness, hope, love for one's neighbor. White is a paradise color and symbolizes purity and spirituality, while yellow, like orange and gold, symbolizes wealth and prosperity. Green, like a fusion of blue and yellow, means prosperity and rebirth. Colorful and painted eggs give a cheerful mood and are the basis of Easter games. Soft-girl is a fashionable style for girls who dress in big jumpers, T-shirts, like to wear jeans and never refuse short skirts. Girls with this style look very cute. Glasses are sometimes used as accessories. In makeup, soft-girls always use blush, draw short arrows, sometimes even freckles. Young princesses who consider themselves to be an e-girl love short plaid skirts with a high waist, a black and white striped turtleneck, and a black T-shirt over the turtleneck. They like to wear belts, chains, tights in a net. Make-ups are effective - long arrows, bright blush, often also use blush with shine and lipstick with shine, which makes the skin shinier and as if moist at first glance. Which style do you like more? Let's arrange a fashion competition for our princesses!

title: Princess Easter hurly-burly
description: The two BFF are preparing for Easter. Help the princesses choose cute Easter bunny outfits. Overalls of delicate colors, short dresses and jeans of unusual colors are in fashion now. Use funny rabbit hats and baskets of Easter eggs to complement the image of the Easter bunny. Do not forget about the cute spring makeup. Princesses suit light pink, blue, lemon and white shades.

title: Harlequin is preparing an April Fools rally
description: Funny Princess Harlequin loves jokes! Soon the famous holiday of laughter and fun - the First of April. The princess must be ready in time for the celebration. Help her choose an unusual clown outfit, as well as make an cool makeup. Use bright and bold color combinations. Harlequin loves colorful funny hairstyles. Rather, play the game «Harlequin is preparing an April Fools rally». Create your festive look for Princess Harlequin and go have fun with friends!

title: Eggle Shooter Mobile
description: Eggle Shooter Mobile is a bubble shooter game with all of the classic features along with new power-ups. Keep the bubbles above the danger line to keep playing.

title: Princess Slime Factory
description: Eliza opens a slime factory! Let's find out how to quickly and easily prepare a beautiful slime at home with the princess. We will need simple ingredients such as liquid soap, shampoo, toothpaste, shaving foam, baking soda, glue, food coloring and glitter. There are several ways to make a slime. Try each one of it. Now that our slime is ready, create a stylish package for it. The design of the slime bottle is an important part of the factory. Making slimes is so much fun!

title: Maja the Bee Coloring Book
description: Maja the Bee Coloring Book is fun coloring game for kids and you can play it for free. Let's play the painting game! Draw some beautiful color for these 2 cute bees! Choose your favorite color to draw and create a unique bee! Have fun in Maja the Bee Coloring Book!

title: Candy Floss Maker
description: Take the role of the fun fair food creator and surprise your customers in a cooking game with some yummy desserts! This making dessert game is a great way to start experiencing first steps into the culinary world of new cooking games!

title: Sand Art
description: Sand Art :Write On Sand is the best sand art game which allows you to draw using your fingers and create masterpieces in the realistic sand! Once the drawing on sand is done, and let the waves wash out the drawing – then, start finger painting again on the canvas of sand!

title: Princess Ready For Christmas
description: With the Christmas Eve round the corner, the excitement always are at peak in the palace. The celebrations are round the corner with everyone gearing up towards it . Being a princess is even more fun. Let’s help the princess wear a cool party outfit for the Christmas Eve and then you will need to help her with the dresses because this is the biggest event in the Palace. Last but not least, help her decorate her Christmas tree with a majestic look

title: Princess Valentine Preparations
description: To celebrate Valentine's day, the princess has decided to be in their best! Let's check out their closet and look at our options. They have a few dresses in their colors of choice, both long and short, sometimes it's more fun to mix it up a bit! You have the additional task of decorating their card and make them geared up for the royal date.

title: Princess Winter Style
description: The princess want to get out in the winter, but are in dilemma in choosing the best outfit. Help them get cute with warm outfits and enjoy spending time with them in this cute new dress up game! The fun does not end there. The princess are on the task of creating the best snow-man. Help them out and bring out the best in you.

title: Princess Trendy T-shirt
description: T-Shirts are available in plenty, the princess are in a state of confusion in choosing the best. It can be styled many ways and they can be a fun accessory that bring color and sass to an outfit. Mix together tops and pants and match it up with the best accessory to give the princess the best look.

title: Princess Spring Fashion
description: Get ready for the most awaited season to spend with the two cute sisters who are absolutely mad about this season!. They have already renewed their spring wardrobe with cherry blossom collections. You should really check out their outfits and accessories for spring. Make sure to pick something chic and pretty. Have fun!

title: BFF St. Patricks Day Preparation
description: Hey Girls! These cute princess are ready for patricks day celebration. So help them to prepare for the carnival by choosing best outfit, hairstyles and accessories. And also help them to decor their hats. It will become so much fun and excitement. Help them.

title: Princess Pastel Fashion
description: Hey Girls! Pastels are totally in this season! That’s why these stylish princesses have decided to design some awesome outfits that feature tons of these colors. They have already decorate their wardrobe with cute pastel dress. Among them Help to choose the best.

title: Princess Stripes Vs Dots
description: The Two little princess of Cutedressup simply adore modern world and fashion. They are trendsetters and best friends. But sometimes their taste in fashion is not the same. As example, one is convinced that this summer's big hit are stripes but other contradicts her, she being convinced that the ultimate trend this summer are dots. Well, they want to prove their point so they want to create a statement outfit. Help them out and explore both styles!

title: Hello Kitty Spot the Difference
description: Hello Kitty Spot the Differences - Welcome to the Unforgettable 'Spot the Difference' game! Test your powers of observation and see if you can find all the differences in this funny online game for kids.

title: Tiny Fish Factory
description: A Classic match 3 game.

title: Hello Kitty Memory Challenge
description: A great memory game for little girls, with Hello Kitty, the cute little white cat. So come and play!

title: Popsy Surprise Princess
description: Do you like to play dolls and draw? Then this game is perfect for you. Cute little popsies turned into princesses, but they lack bright colors. Remember the classic images of princesses or create your own cute popsy-princess!

title: Ben10 Monsters Coloring
description: Ben10 Monsters Coloring Book is an online game that you can play for free. A new coloring game for you! Choose your favorite colors from the palette to paint our Ben10 Monster characters. These coloring pages really stimulate the kids creativity. Color within the lines. You can also download and print the images. Have fun coloring.

title: Stars Chain Matching
description: Connect similar star blocks using touchscreen or mouse. Make a group of 3 or more, horizontally, vertically or diagonally adjacent stars to make their block's color blue. Make all the blocks' blue to complete the level. Complete all 24 levels to win this game.

title: Baby Hazel Learns Vehicles
description: Wow! Baby Hazel is very excited as it's her first day to school. It's time for little Hazel to admit in School and learn more things. She is curious as she is getting a chance to explore new world and that's School'. School is all about new life, new friends, etiquettes, sharing and many more. Help Hazel in getting ready for School. After getting into the classroom, help her and her friends learn more new things. Her School Miss has planned to make learning session in fun way. Play this game and get to know how Baby Hazel spends her first day at school and what she learns new. Get a chance to learn new educational things along with Baby Hazel.

title: Princess Spring Fashion Show
description: Elsa is doing a fashion show this spring. Pick up an elegant evening dress and shoes for this dress. Or you can choose a cheeky bodysuit from a new collection of underwear for princesses. Do not forget to add accessories to your image. Jewels and luxurious clutches just what we needed. Apply makeup to the princess models and start your spring fashion show!

title: Baby Hazel In Preschool
description: Today is Baby Hazel s first day at the preschool. Baby Hazel is in a playful mood and not interested to go. Convince Baby Hazel and get her ready to go to the preschool. When she is in the preschool with other kids, help them perform different activities by fulfilling their needs. Check hint bubbles to know the needs of Baby Hazel and others. Fulfill their needs quickly to earn bonus points. You lose the game if you make the kids cry.

title: Baby Hazel Dental Care
description: Baby Hazel is fond of candies and lollypops. We all know consuming excess of candies can cause dental problems. Our adorable Baby has experienced a severe toothache while she was having lollypop. Take her to dentist as mom is busy in gym. Be with Hazel so that she does not cry seeing the dental instruments used by doctor. Help cute princess in following doctor's advice to maintain dental hygiene.

title: Baby Hazel Birthday Party
description: Hurray! Baby Hazel is celebrating her 3rd birthday. Let us join Hazel to enjoy dancing, feasting and magic shows at her birthday party. On this special occasion, keep Baby Hazel happy by fulfilling all her needs. Someone who is very dear to Hazel has planned a surprise for her to make her birthday more fun-filled. Let us see what the surprise is and who has planned it.

title: Baby Hazel Hand Fracture
description: Baby Hazel got slipped while climbing up the table. Oh no! She is crying in pain as her hand is fractured. Go along with her to doctor for the medical treatment. Baby Hazel cannot move her plastered hand and is unable to perform her routine activities. Can you fulfill her needs and help her in performing routing activities? Take a good care of Baby Hazel and give affectionate treatment to her.

title: Baby Hazel Royal Bath
description: In these days Mom is busy caring and playing with Baby Matt. This has made our darling Hazel lone and sad. But then, Hazel's mother is quick in understanding her princess needs. So today she is going to pamper her daughter by giving a royal bath. Baby Hazel's royal bath starts with a soothing massage. Then let our princess dip herself in soothing chocolate water and that is followed by a milk bath and shower. Finally dress up little princess in her favorite costumes and accessories.

title: Baby Hazel Kitchen Time
description: Little Hazel turns to be chef today and wants to try her hand in cooking. Enjoy shopping utensils and ingredients with Hazel required for preparing meal. Take an extra care of Hazel as she is first involving in cooking activity. When food is ready, be with her to set up dinning table. Once done, then don't wait for ant thing and just start feasting at tasty meal cooked by Hazel.

title: Baby Hazel Kitchen Fun
description: It's time to have some fun in kitchen with Baby Hazel! Today Baby Hazel has to take care of her little brother, Matt as mom is out for some work. As darling Hazel is too young she needs your help in taking care of Matt. Assist Hazel to prepare a yummy fruit treat for Matt using ingredients from her kitchen. Help her in feeding this tasty food to Matt without making him cry for mom. Enjoy pampering Matt and assisting Hazel in this fun-filled game.

title: Baby Hazel Swimming Time
description: Wow! Time for Baby Hazel to learn swimming. Uncle James had promised Hazel to give her swimming lessons and he is keeping his promise now. Baby Hazel prepares herself for the sessions by packing her bag with swimming costumes and other essentials. Help her in packing all the swimming necessities. Then go along with Hazel to the swimming pool and help her in dressing up in swim costumes and gears. Join little angel to learn how to swim as per instructions given by uncle James.

title: Baby Hazel Mischief Time
description: Yeah!!! Baby Hazel is in roguish mood! She has finally got some lonesome time to enjoy. In her Mom's absence, she has planned to revel. She has invited her BFF Mia to have some playful time. Help little Hazel enjoy every bit of time along with buddy Mia. Sshh!!! Her mom may drop in any moment; ensure everything is back at its place before she comes. Help Hazel in cleaning the mess and return to bed before mom returns. Wanna know what Hazel and Mia do in Mom's absence? Play this game and get to know. Have a roguish day with Baby Hazel and Mia!

title: Baby Hazel Leg Injury
description: Baby Hazel and her pet Bruno are playing in the backyard. Oops! Hazel falls down, to her surprise, she injures her leg. Panicked mother gives her first-aid and takes her to the doctor. Help Hazel's mother and the doctor to treat our darling hazel to walk and play as before. Play this level to know how hazel was cured.

title: Baby Hazel Playdate
description: Baby Hazel is going for a playdate to Jake's house. This occasion is planned by their mothers as it has been long time since they met. Moms are busy in their chit-chat and leaves the children to play together. Let's play the game to see whether they were quarreling or playing peacefully? Also check out what interesting outdoor and indoor games did they enjoy? As moms are busy, so you have to take care of kids needs while they play.

title: Baby Hazel Newborn Vaccination
description: Today Baby Matt has to get vaccinated. Little Hazel is little worried as she will first time see Matt being vaccinated. Can you help Baby Hazel in getting cute little Matt ready for the hospital? Be quick so that kids do not miss doctor's appointment. Help Hazel in comforting Matt during his vaccination. Have fun with siblings!

title: Baby Hazel Siblings Day
description: Enjoy celebrating Siblings Day with Baby Hazel and Matt! Help the little ones to create gifts for each other. Go along with them to their playroom and enjoy riding a toy car, playing on the seesaw, bursting colored bubbles and a lot of other fun activities. Enjoy tasty treats and watch Matt giggle while playing pee-a-boo with Hazel. Keep the siblings happy during the celebrations by fulfilling all their needs. Happy National Siblings Day!!

title: Cute Lip Design For Marinett
description: Marinette loves makeup experiments. She is studying at the school of young makeup artists. Today's homework is to create a unique lip design. Marinette uses festive themes and modern trends to make the task better than anyone else. She takes photos of each design on a smartphone. A graceful piercing will help emphasize a fashionable look. Let's join Marinette and try to create a cute lip design!

title: Baby Hazel Pet Party
description: Oh, Baby Hazel's pets are in poor mood. Baby Hazel is left in the question how to cheer them up, ergo, she plans to throw pet party for her pets. She invites her friends too. She felt like even pets need some happening and joyous time. Help Baby in getting all her pets ready for the party and make this party memorable. Pay heed to the needs of Baby Hazel and her friends pets to ensure they have fun at the party. Enjoy this fun filled pet party with Baby Hazel.

title: Baby Hazel Halloween Night
description: It's time to celebrate Halloween with Baby Hazel! Enjoy a memorable Halloween night with Hazel and friends playing fun-packed Halloween games and activities. Go for treat-or-treating, dance to the rocking Halloween music and hangout to Halloween Food Hub for tasty feast. A lot more to enjoy and explore this Halloween season with Baby Hazel and friends. Happy Halloween!!

title: Baby Hazel Hair Care
description: Baby Hazel long hairs are really tough to manage. Moreover, improper hair care has resulted dandruff on her scalp. She needs to trim her hairs, along with an effective dandruff treatment. Fulfill the needs of Hazel and keep her happy by offering her toys while trimming, dandruff treatment and having body and hair wash.

title: Baby Hazel Halloween Party
description: Baby Hazel and her friends are going to have great time in Halloween party. They are dressed in wonderful Halloween costumes and enjoys the party by indulging in Halloween activities and games like trick or treat, magical bowl and many more. They play tricks to scare each other. Halloween party seems to be interesting, isn't it? If yes, then go ahead and join Hazel and her friends to have lots of fun. Some fun activities are bit scary, so be with kids. Serve them tasty snacks and drinks. Fulfill all their needs to make the party memorable!

title: Baby Hazel Grandparents Day
description: Hurray! Today is Grandparents' Day. On this special occasion, Baby Hazel's preschool has invited the kids along with their grandparents. Let's join Hazel and friends to celebrate grandparents' Day along with their grandpa and granny. Help kids to perform dance and magic show and entertain their grandparents. Enjoy making Family Tree with Hazel. Happy Grandparents' Day!

title: Baby Hazel Gums Treatment
description: Maintaining good oral hygiene is very important for healthy gums and teeth! Mom is getting Matt and Hazel ready for the dental checkup. Hazel's gums are bleeding. She needs quick dental treatment. Accompany Hazel to the clinic and help dentist in giving her treatment at the earliest.

title: Baby Hazel Halloween Castle
description: On eve of Halloween Day, Baby Hazel's teacher has arranged a trip to Halloween castle. The castle consists of six mystery rooms, which have many surprises and gifts for Hazel. Let us join Hazel to explore these mystery rooms and have lots of fun. Celebrate Halloween Day with Baby Hazel!!

title: Baby Hazel Halloween Crafts
description: Hurray! Baby Hazel's school is celebrating Halloween crafts making day. Teacher has asked all the kids to bring Halloween crafts and decorate the class. Can you help Hazel in preparing herself for the day. Firstly, help her in making Halloween crafts and designing Halloween costumes. Then be with her to decorate the class. Finally, help her in winning craft competition by making unique craft from available supplies. Have fun with Baby Hazel!!

title: Baby Hazel Granny House
description: Wow! Baby hazel's vacation is full of surprise. Today she is going to her granny's house for the very first time. Hazel is thoroughly excited and wishes to enjoy and each and every moment of being there. Be with darling Hazel and explore her granny's house and nearby areas. Attend all the needs of little lass and her grandparents. While at granny's place Hazel will be befriending with someone. Want to know who? Then play this game. Have fun!

title: Baby Hazel Goldfish
description: Wow!! Baby Hazel is happy to possess a goldfish which luckily fells from stork's beak in the tank. Hazel and Liam are willing to keep this pet with them but they need someone's help to take care of fish. Can you help them? Also help Hazel and Liam to purchase fish tank and items required to decorate it. Join Hazel and her friends to play with Goldie.

title: Baby Hazel Goes Sick
description: It's bright sun outside but our cheerful Baby Hazel, who always wake up early morning is still sleeping. Seems as she is not keeping well. Oh my gosh! She is having high fever along with cold and cough. Rush to doctor for the medical aid. Be with Hazel to pamper her, while medical check-up is going on. Pay heed to all her requirements and make her happy.

title: Baby Hazel Friendship Day
description: Baby Hazel and friends are excited to celebrate Friendship Day with their new friend, Kenny. Let's join the kids to celebrate most fun-filled Friendship Day party. Visit funfair to enjoy fun rides, go for a day out and enjoy tasty treats. Make this day memorable for kids by fulfilling all their requirements on time. Happy Friendship Day!

title: Baby Hazel Easter Fun
description: Hurray! It's Easter Sunday. Baby hazel is eggs-tremely excited as she will be participating in Easter rally along with her pets and friends. She has many plans for the day and has to get ready for the rally. But before that Baby Hazel wishes to make beautiful Easter Goody Basket with colorful Easter eggs. Be with Baby Hazel and have a joyous day. Happy Easter!!!

title: Baby Hazel Valentine's Day
description: Yuppie! It's Valentine's Day. It's the season of love and romance. Baby Hazel is keen to celebrate Valentine's Day with her Mom and Dad along with Grandpa, little Matt and her pets. As her parents are out, she along with her Grandpa plans to surprise parents by arranging party and makes gifts. Wanna know what she gifts them? And what else she does to surprise her parents? Play this love imbued game along with Hazel and keep an eye on her and Grandpa's needs. Help her in completing all tasks before her parents drops in. Sshh! Baby Hazel wants to surprise them. So, hurry up! Celebrate this Valentine's Day with Baby Hazel and her family.

title: Baby Hazel Sibling Surprise
description: Baby Hazel is very fond of her little brother Matt. She is anxious to keep him happy. As Hazel is too young to look after the needs of Matt, can you help her? Assist her in changing Matt's nappy and dressing him up in beautiful baby outfits. Go shopping for cute baby room decoration items along with Hazel and help her to decorate Matt's room. Help Hazel to keep Matt happy by fulfilling all his needs. Enjoy your time with the siblings!!

title: Baby Hazel Gingerbread House
description: Christmas bells are ringing! Our darling Baby Hazel had a dream in which gingerbread man has asked her to renovate gingerbread house. Hazel needs your help in rebuilding gingerbread house, swimming pool, candy train, snowman, gingerbread girl, and decorating Christmas tree. Click on the different activity icons to complete the task.

title: Holubets Home Farming and Cooking
description: Stuffed Cabbage Rolls is known as Holubets. Here in this game we will farm the vegetables in the home backyard and then use those vegetables in cooking the delicious Holubets. Come lets enjoy the game.

title: Baby Hazel Garden Party
description: Yippee! Baby Hazel plans to host a Garden Party for her friends. But Hazel cannot set everything for the party on her own as she is too young and need someone's help. Can you help her in making party arrangements? Firstly, help her in sending invitation to her friends. Then dress up darling Hazel in nice flowerprint costumes and accessories. Finally, join Hazel and her friends to enjoy interesting games and activities in the party.

title: Baby Hazel Flower Girl
description: Wow! Baby Hazel's Aunt Lisa is getting married and in her wedding she wants Baby Hazel to be her Flower Girl. Baby Hazel is very excited for this and hence she goes for shopping with her mom. Baby Hazel is very choosy for her dress, so help her in selecting dress, shoes and accessories best suitable for her. Fun is not finished yet. She needs some makeover to look very pretty. Help her with her makeup to make her look most beautiful girl and finally dress her up as Flower Girl.

title: Baby Hazel Gardening Time
description: Gardening is truly a great fun! Baby Hazel has lot of interest in gardening and wishes to grow some plants at her backyard garden. Help her in knowing the basic needs for growing plants. Select tools and costumes for her which she needs while gardening. Have a great time with Hazel while digging soil, sowing seeds and watering the plant. And yes, also help our darling Hazel in making beautiful bouquet of veggies and roses for her mom.

title: Elena and Sarah Makeover and Dressup
description: Elena and Sarah are long time friends. Sarah is a cute mermaid, she has come ashore to meet Elena. Help both of them get a good makeover and dress up for the occasion.

title: Cutie Unicorn Care
description: Help this Cute Unicorn get better. Take her to the clinic and do a general checkup and then treatment in the nose and mouth. Once the treatment is over, give her a nice bath and then feed her. Take good care of this cute unicorn.

title: Cute Angel Fasionistas
description: In this game we will have Three Cute Angels. You will be doing Facial, Hairspa and Face Spa for the three Angels and then do Makeover and Dressup. Enjoy

title: Baby Hazel Fishing Time
description: Yuppie! It is time to go fishing! Today Baby Hazel's uncle is going to take our little angel for fishing. So she is very busy getting ready for the new adventure. Do you want to go fishing with Baby Hazel and Uncle John? If yes, first of all you need to help Baby Hazel to pack required essentials for fishing. Then be with them while they do fishing together. Keep Baby Hazel and Uncle John happy by fulfilling their needs on time. Happy fishing with Baby Hazel!!

title: Baby Hazel First Rain
description: Lets enjoy Baby Hazel's first rain with her friend and Bunny the hare. Oh no! Calm her down as she gets frightened with the thunders and rain. Help them to enjoy thoroughly in rain. Let's meet Hazel's new friends at the garden who enjoys the rains with her. Let's play to see how mischievous Hazel and her friends can be at the garden. Help them to enjoy every moment. Be ready to explore Hazel's first rain. Here you GO!!

title: Baby Hazel Father's Day
description: It's Father's Day today! Help Baby Hazel to make this day memorable for dad. Join dad and Hazel to enjoy fun-filled games and activities. Go along with Hazel to candy-land and win a Father's Day gift for her dad. Finally, join Hazel and family for outing and enjoy hearty treat. Happy Father's Day!!!

title: Baby Hazel Farm Tour
description: This time Hazel is at her uncle's farm. She loves animals and to work at the farm. Play this game to help Hazel enjoy at the farm and help Uncle Sam.

title: Baby Hazel Fancy Dress
description: Baby Hazel is too excited to participate in fancy dress competition held at her school. To dress up as per Birds And Animals-themed competition, Hazel decides to look cute in peacock costume. Help mom and Hazel to purchase the necessities required for designing the costume. Then help them in tailoring the peacock costumes and making related accessories. Lastly, get Hazel ready for the competition. And yes, don't miss to watch a play enacted by kids to convey an important message!

title: Baby Hazel Family Picnic
description: Hurray! There is a holiday treat for Baby Hazel! Hazel and family are going for a picnic. As mom is a busy feeding Matt, help Hazel to pack picnic basket. The join Hazel and family to enjoy toy train ride, feast on delicious snacks, play fun-filled games and a lot more. Have a blissful day with Baby Hazel and family at the picnic spot.

title: Baby Hazel Fairyland
description: Hurray! Baby Hazel has got an excellent opportunity to explore the fairyland. A magician is ready to send her to fairyland on one condition that Hazel will bring pink flower as a gift for him. Let's join Hazel to help her in finding a pink flower and explore magical land of fairly filled with a lot of surprises. Enjoy an adventurous fairyland tour with Hazel!

title: Miss Beautiful Fairy Contest
description: Kindly help this beautiful fairy to prepare herself for the Fairy Beauty Content.

title: Saty & Carl Wedding Photo Shoot
description: Saty and Carl are getting ready for their wedding. So they are planning to have a pre wedding photoshoot. Kindly help Saty and Carl have a relaxing Spa and a good makeover and dressup for this photoshoot.

title: Baby Hazel Eye Care
description: Baby Hazel is having infection in her eyes! She needs a quick medical treatment. Go along with Hazel to clinic for the eyes treatment. Be with her and look after her needs during the checkup. Help an eye specialist to treat Hazel's eyes with care and love. Carefully listen to doctor's instructions and help Hazel to follow them for quick recovery.

title: Baby Hazel Earth Day
description: Baby Hazel needs to know the importance of how to maintain environment. As its World Earth Day', let's help Baby Hazel in learning more about this annual event to protect environment. The Day is celebrated to promote green environment by saving plants, electricity and many more. Baby Hazel is curious to participate in this event held at nearby park. Play this game to know what Baby Hazel does on this day. Join hands with Baby Hazel and go green!

title: Claire Learns Culinary Skills
description: Claire wants to learn how to decorate fruits and vegetables. In this game, you will help Claire purchase the fruits and vegetables and also learn the art of beautifully decorating them on a plate. Enjoy the game.

title: Baby Hazel Dining Manners
description: As Baby Hazel is growing up, it`s time for her to learn one more important lesson, Dining manners. Dining etiquette are as important as any other manners. It`s vital part of culture. Baby Hazel is quick in learning and we are sure with your help she will learn it soon. Help this adroit kid to learn Dining manners as soon as possible.

title: Baby Hazel Dinosaur Park
description: It's holiday treat for Baby Hazel today! Hazel and her cousins have flown to visit the Dinosaur Park. Each zone in the park if filled with a lot of activities and surprise gifts. Let's join the kids to enjoy a lot of fun-filled games and activities. Fulfill all the needs of Baby Hazel and cousins so that they enjoy their day out to the fullest. Have fun!

title: Baby Hazel Cooking Time
description: It's time for Baby Hazel to explore her cooking skills! Baby Hazel is hungry and mom is not at home. Can you assist Hazel in preparing her favorite snacks? Accompany her to shopping mall for purchasing ingredients required for cooking. Then help her in preparing her favorite mini quiches and fruit wand. Finally, join Hazel and her cute pets on the dining table for enjoying a hearty meal.

title: Emma Play Time
description: Emma Play Time is a fun supermarket shopping girl game that gives you an idea of how supermarkets and shopping malls work and offers you an unforgettable virtual grocery shopping experience! From food shopping games and clothes shopping, to cleaning games, recycling and slicing food games, there’s just so many fun and creative activities in our “supermarket games with many levels”!

title: Baby Hazel Dolphin Tour
description: Baby Hazel and her family plan a dolphin tour to explore the delightful world of dolphins. They enjoy the dolphin dance and many other spectacular performances by dolphins at the Dolphin park. Hazel also gets a chance to play and interact with dolphins and learn a few interesting facts related to them. Enjoy a blissful time with lovable dolphins along with our darling princess in this thrilling exotic Dolphin tour!!!

title: Baby Hazel Daycare
description: Today mom and dad will be out of town for some important work. So, mom will be dropping Baby Hazel and Matt at daycare. It's first time that kids will be visiting the daycare. Can you help nanny to keep siblings happy by paying heed to all their demands. Play games, feed them and help them in socializing with other kids. Enjoy daycare fun with Baby Hazel!

title: Baby Hazel Crafts Time
description: It's time for Baby Hazel to show and share her creative skills. Today Baby Hazel is working on her craft assignment which she has to submit in her school. On realizing she is running out of time, Hazel seeks help from you in completing the assignment. Begin the game by helping her in finding and shopping for needful stuffs for the assignment in stationary shop. Then complete the assignment and present it to the teacher. Let's see what teacher rewards Baby Hazel when she sees her craft assignment. With this game Baby Hazel also shares her craft skills with you. Play this game and have fun-filled craft time with Baby Hazel.

title: Baby Hazel Doctor Play
description: Baby Hazel is goes to a mall for shopping with her mother. She buys a doctor play set. But suddenly her teddy gets injured while playing. Play this game to help Hazel be a good doctor and treat her teddy with medicines and love.

title: Baby Hazel Cleaning Time
description: Baby Hazel is growing fast and now understands the importance of cleanliness for better lifestyle and healthy life. Cleaning the house and surrounding area is as important as other social etiquettes. Today darling Baby Hazel is all set to offer helping hand to her mom in cleaning the house. As Hazel is still young to perform cleaning activities, shepherd her in getting her house clean along with mom. Play now!

title: Baby Hazel Christmas Time
description: Merry Christmas everyone! Today, Baby Hazel is celebrating Christmas along with her friends, Bella & Liam, along with Honey Bonny and Katy, the cute little cat. She is eagerly waiting for Santa and very excited about what she is going to receive in presents. So she wants to complete all Christmas preparations as soon as possible. She has to pack gifts, make snowman and ride on snowboard, play snow fight and many more. This is good opportunity to celebrate Christmas with Baby Hazel and her friends too. Play this game and help her in completing all activities before Santa arrives. See what Santa gifts Baby Hazel. So, what are you waiting for? Enjoy Christmas night along with Baby Hazel & her friends.

title: Baby Hazel Christmas Surprise

Players can also share their creations with friends and family, or even challenge them to see who can bake the best pie. title: My Town Home: Family Playhouse
description:
Discover **My Town Home: Family Playhouse**, a vibrant online dollhouse adventure that sparks your imagination. Explore six unique rooms, create family narratives, and enjoy activities like cooking and gardening. Play for **free** on your phone or computer and craft your ideal virtual family experience.

Controls:
Desktop: Right-click on buttons, move items and characters with the mouse.
Mobile: Tap on buttons, move items and characters with your finger.

Key Features:
• Endless possibilities: You have an entire house at your disposal! Play out your stories and interact with the environment. Cook in the spacious kitchen, turn on the TV, and much more!
• Your sandbox: The game doesn't limit your creativity! Create your own plots and come up with unique stories!
• Mini-games: Play various mini-games to earn a little extra! Wash the teddy bear or pop the right balloons, and much more. This adds variety to your experience!

Levels / Maps / Worlds:
• You have access to a large two-story house with different locations!
• Kitchen: A big kitchen with a large table and a smaller one just for kids! Plenty of space to cook delicious meals. A wonderful place for a big family!
• Backyard: A fantastic spot for fun stories! Play in the sandbox, jump on the trampoline, or have a picnic outdoors, and much more!

Story / Setting:
You are the author of your own story. Create tales and bring them to life in the game!

Core Gameplay & Story
Q: What is the goal of the game?
A: You have an entire house at your disposal! Choose a family to live here. Play out your stories, cook meals, play in the backyard, tend to plants, and much more. Play mini-games to earn some extra and buy something!

Q: Is there a storyline?
A: In the game, you are the author of your own story. Create tales in a large house where everyone can find their place!

Q: What grabs attention in the first few minutes?
A: The large interactivity in the house. Turn on the computer, bake something in the oven, make smoothies, change outfits, and much more. Combined with character selection and the ability to role-play your stories, your plots can become much more vivid!

Mechanics & Progression
Q: How many levels are there / is the structure clear?
A: The game features one large two-story house. It has children's rooms, a parents' room, a bathroom, a kitchen, a backyard, and other locations. You have plenty of space to explore your ideas!

Q: What unlocks as you play?
A: As you progress, you will unlock new mini-games and characters for your stories!

Economy & Customization
Q: Are there skins / customization options?
A: You can change the clothing for your characters. Choose the right outfit for your story!

Q: What is available from the start?
A: Most activities in the game are available from the very beginning. You can start your story without restrictions! Plant flowers, choose outfits. At the start, you have access to 2 mini-games: pop the right balloons and wash the teddy bear!

Retention & Engagement
Q: Are there daily challenges / a wheel of fortune / achievements / tasks?
A: A robot vacuum moves around the house. It carries a wheel of fortune! Take advantage of the moment and try your luck to win prizes!

Q: Is sound necessary?
A: Sound is not required, but it can immerse you in the atmosphere of home life!

Q: What achievements are there and how can they be earned?
A: Collect cards! By collecting cards, you can gather all the pieces for a family album. It's always nice to enjoy good moments!

Q: Is there onboarding in the game? What is it like?
A: You will understand everything from the first minutes in the game. The game will show you all the basic mechanics, and you'll quickly get the hang of it!

💃Dive into the world of fashion and style absolutely free, with the new game “Fashion Princess - Dress Up for Girls.” This game is available in Russian and is ideal for girls of all ages. It is also suitable for fans of games such as
"Avatar Dressing Race", "Fashion Queen: Dress Up Game", "Fashion Battle" and "Fashion Show".

👑Feel like a real princess and fashion designer!

👗 In this game you will find:
- Dress Up Race: Dress up your princess with gorgeous dresses and accessories.
- Fashion Battles: Participate in fashion battles and prove that your model is a real beauty queen. Choose the right clothes and get the highest marks from the judges.
- Variety of outfits: Wide variety of clothes, including princess dresses, shoes, jewelry and more. Show your creativity and create the perfect look.

🏆Show off your fashion designer skills. Play online, unlock new items and become a top model!

title: Kiki World: Kawaii Doll Decor
description: Kiki World is a home design game where you transform cluttered rooms into stylish living spaces. By cleaning, removing old items, and arranging chic furniture, you’ll bring empty areas to life with your personal touch. Perfect for design enthusiasts, it challenges your creativity as you decorate, makeover, and create the dream home you’ve always imagined.

title: Ellie Summer Spa Beauty Salon
description: Ellie Summer Spa: a soothing shore where beauty and joy are yours to explore! With gentle care, her glow will bloom. Play to find a sweet escape in a sunlit room!

title: Anime Couple: Avatar Maker
description:
Anime Couple: Avatar Maker, the ultimate anime avatar character creation experience! Dive into the world of anime with our cutting-edge app that lets you design anime avatar faces, dress up girl avatars, and create the coolest anime couple characters you've ever seen.

🌟 Key Features 🌟

👫 Romantic Anime Couple Creation: Unleash your inner artist and craft breathtaking anime couple avatars that radiate love and passion.

👗 Anime Dress Up Girl Avatar: Design your perfect anime girl with a wide range of stylish outfits, accessories, and hairstyles.

🤩 Cool Anime Avatar Maker: Get ready to be amazed by the sheer coolness of our avatar creator.

💏 Avatar Couple ASMR: Dive into a relaxing ASMR experience as you create your dream anime couple.

🎨 Anime Cartoon Avatar: Bring your imagination to life with our anime-inspired art style.

👑 Avatar Couple Creator: Be the mastermind behind the most captivating anime couples.

title: Kendel 7 Days 7 Styles
description: In 7 Days 7 Styles, you’re dressing for fun: from sunrise to sunset, there’s looks to be spun; beach day or brunch, gym or the mall, style it your way and wow them all!

title: Back To School: Uniforms Edition
description: Explore global fashion in Back to School: Uniforms Edition! This fun dress-up game lets you spin the wheel to unlock school uniforms from countries like Japan, the U.S., the U.K., India, France, and South Korea. Customize your character with stylish outfits, accessories, and hairstyles inspired by each culture. Dive into the diversity of school uniforms and become a fashion expert while having fun!

title: Fashion Week 2025
description: Get ready to rule the runway in Fashion Week 2025! Style 5 stunning models in high-fashion looks for the most glamorous fashion event of the year! From Chanel-inspired elegance to punk rock rebellion, create jaw-dropping outfits across five unique themes. Mix and match couture dresses, bold accessories, and trendy hairstyles to make every model shine! Are you ready to become the ultimate fashion stylist? Play now and slay the runway!

title: Anime Avatar Maker: Anime Doll
description:
Game features:
✨ Choose different skin tones, hair styles, hair colors, eyes expressions and stylish dresses with lots of decoration items.
✨ Various hairstyles, different themes, and dressing up anime characters!
✨ Beautiful graphic art and high quality sound, well-arranged anime background scenes, a different photo experience!
✨ 2 different modes: Doll maker and PK

title: Sort And Style: Back To School
description: Step into the world of Sort And Style: Back To School, a fun mix of sorting and dress-up games for girls! Organize messy desks, lockers, wardrobes, and even bento boxes across 9 exciting levels. Then, challenge your creativity in the final dress-up unit where you style your school look with trendy uniforms, shoes, hairstyles, and accessories. Perfect for fans of organizing games, makeover fun, and school fashion challenges!

title: Paper Doll Diary - Chibi Dolls
description: Paper Doll Diary - Chibi Dolls is an Android game developed by Bravestars Games. This free game allows users to create stunning photos and fabulous videos featuring their own personalized dolls.

title: Bingo Mania
description:
A casual bingo progression game. Complete Kitchen Quest levels to gather ingredients, cook recipes from cupcakes to a grand feast, and unlock Bingo Battles at level 25 where you can play against other players in the game!

In Kitchen Quest, you play through 100 solo levels — numbers are called, you daub matching cells, and complete patterns (lines, corners, themed shapes) to win. Every victory earns ingredients and recipe progress through stages: gather, prep, cook, decorate, and serve.

Cook your way through five kitchen tiers: cupcake, pizza, burger, cake, and a grand feast. Serve your first dish in just 5 levels, then tackle longer recipes as difficulty ramps up with more cards, tighter timers, and special tiles.

At level 25, unlock Bingo Battles — timed head-to-head duels against rival chefs. Outscore them before time runs out in ranked Trophy Duels or casual practice matches. There’s also a Chef Battles ladder gauntlet, daily tasks, leagues, and seasonal rewards.

Portrait-first mobile design makes it easy to play on the go.

title: Anna's Story: Dress Up DIY
description:
🎀 Anna's Story: Dress Up DIY takes you into a magical world of creativity and fashion! In this charming paper doll game, you’ll help Anna dress up for a variety of occasions, from costume parties and romantic dates to festive holidays like Halloween and Christmas.

👗 Endless Outfit Choices

Explore a wardrobe full of stunning clothes and accessories tailored to each event. Whether it’s a spooky Halloween costume or a dazzling Christmas outfit, you’ll find the perfect look for Anna.

✨ Fairy Tale Vibes

With its adorable art style and enchanting themes, this game makes every moment feel like you’re styling a fairy princess. Every outfit you create adds a touch of magic to Anna’s story.

title: Little Princess Dress Up
description:
Why You'll Love Little Princess Dress Up:

✨ Fashion Battles with Other Players: Showcase your style skills by battling it out with other players. May the best fashion creator win!

✨ Capture Your Creations: Take pictures of your dressed-up dolls and save them to your gallery. Share your designs with friends or keep them as your fashion portfolio.

✨ Special Princess Dresses: Access a collection of special dresses, including princess gowns that will make your doll look like royalty.

✨ Adorable Chibi Graphics: Dive into a game with cute and adorable graphics that will melt your heart with every outfit you create.

✨ Healing Sounds: Enjoy the healing soundtracks that make your dress-up experience even more relaxing and enjoyable.

✨ Be a Doll Avatar Maker: Create your favorite character with a wide range of customization options, bringing your ideal chibi doll to life.

title: Nail Salon
description: Nail Salon is a creative and fun nail beauty art experience where you transform clients’ nails into dazzling works of beauty. Step into a vibrant salon, welcome your customers, and unleash your artistic skills to create stunning makeovers. Express your creativity with endless designs and colors, making each client’s nails truly shine. 💅✨

title: Pop Culture Halloween Makeup
description: Immerse yourself in the world of Pop Culture Halloween Makeup, where you can transform into your favorite pop culture icons. With a wide array of hairstyles, eyeshadows, mascaras, lipsticks, blush options, neck paint, tops, and accessories, you can create stunning Halloween makeup looks that will leave everyone in awe. Unleash your imagination, experiment with different styles, and become the ultimate makeup artist. Tap into the spirit of Halloween and play Pop Culture Halloween Makeup now to embark on a spooktacular journey!

title: K-Pop Halloween Dress Up
description: Get spooky and stylish with K-Pop Halloween Dress Up! Dress the Huntrix girls in hauntingly chic outfits like Witch, Pumpkin Queen, Vampire Idol, and more. Mix costumes, accessories, and spooky face paint to create bold Halloween looks for your favorite idols. Show off your fashion skills and celebrate Halloween K-pop style in this fun dress up game!

title: Funny Rescue Pet
description: Lica and Purry had an accident! Lica's house is on fire, and Purry is soak wet when she played inside the wall. How can it happen? Rescue them immediately and also give them some makeover!

title: Darling Doll: DIY Paper Doll
description:
• Characters: We offer a large selection of famous model characters to choose from (from famous princesses to anime females).
• Experiment with different dress styles, haircuts, expressions, and skin tones.
• A wide range of accessories for your character!
• Customize your dolls with over 1000 pieces, and build your anime character, your avatar.

title: Girl Hair Salon & Dress Up
description:
In the game Hair and Beauty, you can experiment with the latest trends in hairdressing and fashion:

💇‍♀️ **Create stunning looks**
Offer your clients a variety of hairstyles, from trendy cuts to elegant updos.
🎨 **Express yourself with makeup**
Choose from a wide range of makeup products and styles to complete your clients' looks.
👗 **Dress to impress**
Select from hundreds of outfits and accessories to help your clients look their best.
💎 **Unlock new possibilities**
Earn rewards as you progress through the game and expand your salon's offerings.
📸 **Capture the moment**
Take photos of your clients before and after their transformations to share with your friends and the world!

title: Black Friday Dress Up Selfie
description: Shop the best looks in Black Friday Dress Up Selfie! Help your fashionista choose outfits from her wishlist, cozy fall fits, warm winter layers, sparkly holiday glam, and dark-academia vibes. Mix tops, bottoms, dresses, shoes, and accessories to create the perfect selfie-ready style. A fun, fast way to solve every “What should I wear?” moment!

title: Summer Fashion Makeover
description: Lily has been neglected her look for a long time in pandemic time. When the summer come and things get better, she wants to go to the beach again. But look at her! What a scary look she has now! Let's help makeover her to be pretty and neat again!

title: Mike and Mia 1st Day School
description: Mike and Mia are very excited for their first day of school. Help them to clean their room and make a delicious snack box. Get dressed up with various cute clothes. Enjoy the first day at school with fun and loving playful activities!

title: BFF Easter Photobooth Party
description: Get the girls all set: it’s time to shine, dress them up in outfits so fine; strike a pose with flair and cheer for Easter fun and style are here!

title: Hair Salon 3D
description:
Hair Salon 3D — a vibrant 3D hair salon simulator! Clients come to you with all kinds of requests: bob cuts, mohawks, undercuts, long layers, and much more. Pick up scissors, clippers, a razor, and a color brush — cut, style, and dye hair, trying to recreate the requested hairstyle as accurately as possible.

The better the result — the more stars and tips you earn! Collect in-game currency, buy new tools and dyes, unlock complex haircuts, and serve VIP clients. 23 unique hairstyles, 5 tools, a rating system, and daily challenges — you'll never get bored!

title: Funny Pet Haircut
description: Take your messy pets, alpaca and cat to the hair salon. Wash and dry your pets before giving them a brand new look by changing their colors and giving them pattern look. Dress up too. And turn them into a stylish beauty!

title: DIY Ugly Christmas Sweater
description: Get ready to deck the halls with festive creativity in DIY Ugly Christmas Sweater! Join three BFFs as they design their unique ugly Christmas sweaters for an epic holiday party. Choose sweater colors and decorate them with Christmas trees, reindeer, snowmen, globes, lights, bows, and more! Complete their holiday looks with new hairstyles and festive accessories. Show off your holiday spirit and create the ultimate cozy, ugly sweater masterpiece in this fun and festive game!

title: Good and Evil DressUp
description: Dive into the enchanting world of a sorceress at a magical academy in "Good and Evil DressUp." Experiment with striking outfits that blend good and evil, featuring everything from shiny leather to elegant satin. Enjoy this free online game on your phone or computer, unleashing your creativity in limitless fashion.

title: Funny Hair Salon
description: George's hair is in a no bueno situation. His scalp is full of mites and pimps. The only way to fix his hair is going to the salon. Let's cure his scalp and plant new hair to his head, so he can show his true outter beauty!

title: Tom and Angela Insta Fashion
description: Help Tom & Angela to become Instagram famous. Buy and choose clothes, hairstyles, or accessories by following their moods. Make them look stunning on every occasion, take beautiful pictures to post on Instagram and receive lots of likes. Get their insta-ready outfits and have fun!

title: Ink Shop: Dress & Tattoo Games
description: 🎨 Ink Shop: Dress & Tattoo offers a unique and creative experience where you not only create stunning ink tattoos but also dress up characters in trending outfits! Dive into the world of fashion and tattoos, where your artistic talents can shine in more ways than one.

title: Blondie in the Real World
description: Blondie lives in her perfect doll world. She is happy, but one day she realizes that something is wrong with her life. Her life is too artificial and perfect. Blondie decides to go to the real world to feel real. Help the Blonde to embody her image in makeup. Bake a cake for the guests and put things in order with Blondie in her new apartment. Choose an adorable party outfit for her and remember that Blondie's favorite colors are pink, gold and white.

title: Easter Funny Makeup
description: Eliza and her niece are getting ready for Easter in the most creative way—by designing festive face art! Use cheerful symbols of the season like Easter eggs, bunnies, flowers, butterflies, and rainbows to craft a bright and joyful spring look.

title: Fashionista Christmas Eve Party
description: Indulge in the Fashionista Christmas Eve Party extravaganza! Discover glamorous holiday ensembles, festive accessories, and the perfect blend of chic for a stylish celebration. Join the fashion-forward festivities and elevate your Christmas Eve style to new heights. Unwrap the magic of the season with Fashionista, where every outfit is a statement and every moment is a fashion triumph. Let the glamour of Christmas Eve unfold.

title: Funny Angela Haircut
description: Give Angela the best hairstyle ever! Enjoy tons of professional tools like curling irons, blow dryers, scissors, magic hair growing spray, and so much more! Dye her hair in any variety of colors. Complete the makeover with stylish outfit, mix and match cute clothes and dress up Angela to become more fashionable!

title: Kuromi Maker
description: Design your very own Kuromi-style character with a vast array of customization options and a diverse color palette. With just one click, you can generate a randomly created hero—sometimes with hilarious results! If you''re not happy with the outcome, you can reset everything at any moment. Once you''re satisfied with your creation, save it as a PNG image.

title: Magic Princess
description: Magic Princess - Dress up & Character Maker offline game, come and design the cutest doll👑! Magic Princess is a fashionable ultra-casual simulation girl game with a strong anime chibi style, suitable for all unique girls to play. 【Game Features】 👸 Avatar Creator & Memoji Maker 👸 Make up your own versions of international star girls or gothic charming dolls! 👸 More than 1000+ dress up items, skin tones and hairdressing! 👸 High quality animation in some clothes and items, you will definitely love it! 👸 Create more gorgeous photos, fabulous videos about your dolls 👸 Give your friends your painted, lovely doll girl. 👸 Keep track of every innovative designs

title: Besties on Wednesday
description: A young bestie goes to school to learn magic and make new friends. She has her own special style. The girl prefers black colors in clothes and a gothic look. Her roommate likes bright colors in her clothes. It will not be easy for new acquaintances to find a common language. However, this bright girl is not as simple as it seems at first glance. She has her secrets. Try to choose for each student an image that suits her perfectly. And one day these besties will be BFF.

title: Funny Rescue Gardener
description: Samantha is a great gardener, but even the best will get accidents sometimes. Let's play and rescue Samantha from the horrible accident! Help her recover from the wounds and have fun!

title: Black Friday Mystery Sale
description: Dive into the excitement of Black Friday shopping with a twist! In the Black Friday Mystery Sale dress up game, fashion surprises await, and it's up to you to style the princesses with fabulous outfits hidden inside the mystery boxes. Ready for a shopping spree you’ll never forget? Start playing now!

title: 11 Kisses
description: Join the thrilling journey of "11 Kisses," where you aid Angel-Girl and Demon-Boy in their fight for love. Solve intriguing puzzles across diverse terrains to help them overcome obstacles. Accessible on both mobile and desktop, immerse yourself in this enchanting tale of passionate reunion.

title: Dress Up Anime Girl
description: Anime DressUp is a fun online game that lets you style a cute anime princess. With a variety of outfits, hairstyles, and makeup, you can unleash your creativity and fashion skills. Enjoy creating unique looks and make your princess a standout fashionista in her realm!

title: Hipsters vs Rockers
description: Gaia, Ero and Ai are best friends forever. They like to try the latest fashion and compare with one another that suits them. This time they tried the style of rockers and hipsters. Wonder which fashion is suitable for them?

title: Gothic New Era
description: A goth-girl arrives at the new Academy. She did not suspect that she would fall into a nightmare, the abode of chaos and mysterious riddles. She will definitely like it there. But before the trip, the gothic princess needs to update her wardrobe while staying true to style. Only dark, gloomy shades, gothic dresses and school uniforms. Join her and help the gothgirl create a unique image of the dark princess and find friends.
